name: facm
description: Field Action Closure Monitoring — local analytics dashboard for BSC Field Action Customer Lists

scripts.build: npm run build -w @facm/core && npm run build -w @facm/server && npm run build -w @facm/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @facm/core && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @facm/server" "npm run dev -w @facm/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @facm/core && npm run test -w @facm/server
